<details>
<summary>Source fixes still needed (not in this PR)</summary>

1. `amd/quant_utils.cuh` has no bf16/half `scaled_convert`, so the Kimi-K3 ds_mla fp8 insert truncates instead of encoding.
2. `layers/mhc.py:71` initializes HIP in the parent on import, which forces spawn.
3. `benchmarks/forward/capture.py` records external events inside HIP graph capture, so replay hangs.
4. glm5next AMD KDA grid z = N*HV overflows 65535 (the NVIDIA copy moved it to gridDim.x).
5. `router/dsv4_topk.py` gates a plain Triton kernel on `is_cuda()`. It passes on gfx950, but needs perf and lm_eval before enabling.
6. `fusion/fused_act_quant.py` registers the ReLU2 static-FP8 producer only for CUDA SM90+.
7. `jit_warmup_triton_helper.py` disables parallel Triton compile on ROCm; the AMD LLVM abort needs a root cause.
8. `utils/jit_monitor.py` disables the TileLang hook on ROCm (#51159).
9. compressed-tensors `transform/module.py` calls CUDA-only `hadacore_transform` with no ROCm fallback.
10. `inc_mxfp4_moe.py` falls back to Marlin on ROCm instead of the AITER MXFP4 backend.
11. qwen4_exp `amd/ops/hc.py` does not accept `injection_logits=None`.
12. deepseek_v41 `amd/vl_model.py:343` materializes the whole checkpoint instead of streaming it.
13. `vocab_parallel_embedding.py` enables the fused embedding only on CUDA, though the kernel passes on ROCm.
14. `kernels/triton/activation.py:103` marks the `gelu_and_mul_sparse` Triton provider as CUDA-only.
15. `csrc/topk.cu`: `persistent_topk` is a stub on ROCm.
16. `BlockWiseTorchFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.is_supported` returns True on ROCm without 128x128 block scaling.
17. fp8_e5m2 KV is advertised by ROCM_ATTN/TRITON_ATTN but not dispatched.
18. Helion has no `amd_instinct_*` tuned configs.
19. batch-invariant persistent matmul has no gfx942/gfx950 buckets.
20. Torch symmetric memory is gated to CUDA, although ROCm torch exposes `_SymmetricMemory`.
21. deepseek_v41 aux-stream event joins leave intermittently stale compressor state after HIP graph replay.
22. qwen4_exp `amd/ops/hc.py` registers the same `vllm::qwen4_exp_*` op names as the NVIDIA module.
23. `moe_use_td_hw_supported` returns False on ROCm, but the TD paths pass 10/10 on gfx950.
24. `Fp8MoEMethod.process_weights_after_loading` normalizes to fnuz unconditionally, so reloading trips the e4m3fn assert.

</details>

24. `Fp8MoEMethod.process_weights_after_loading` normalizes to fnuz unconditionally, so reloading trips the e4m3fn assert.
